reason: After the wandering scare I want something now, but I can't tell from this listing whether the live video and SOS actually connect when mum is lost at 2am on a bad signal. I won't pay $249 plus $19.99 a month on a promise I can't test before the emergency.
objection: Will the video actually connect in a real emergency, and does it still work when the mobile data drops or she's indoors?
would_change_my_mind: A real owner in a caregiver group telling me it connected reliably during a wandering episode, or a free or refundable trial I can run on mum before I commit.
